hero.title: Transform Organizational Health Into Social Impact
hero.subtitle: A regenerative model where stronger companies directly support stronger communities—powered by data and aligned with the SDGs.

whyImpactMatters.title: Why Impact Matters
whyImpactMatters.subtitle: Closing the gap between organizational well-being and community regeneration

points.title: Impact Stays Internal
points.description: Companies invest heavily in culture and well-being, but impact often stops inside the organization.

points.title: Communities Need Sustainable Support
points.description: Social challenges in LATAM—especially in indigenous, rural, and women-led communities—lack sustainable, long-term support.

points.title: CSR is Fragmented
points.description: Traditional CSR is fragmented, short-term, and not connected to business performance.

points.title: COIREA Bridges the Gap
points.description: COIREA closes this gap by linking organizational vitality to community regeneration.

coireaSocial.title: Introducing COIREA Social
coireaSocial.subtitle: Social Impact
coireaSocial.description: COIREA Social channels time, skills, and smart capital from participating organizations into high-impact community projects across Latin America. Your organizational improvements—well-being, collaboration, leadership—translate into tangible SDG-aligned contributions tracked inside the platform.

impactModel.title: The Regenerative Impact Model
impactModel.subtitle: A three-step mechanism that transforms organizational growth into community impact

steps.title: Measure & Improve
steps.description: Culture, leadership, well-being, and collaboration strengthen through the COIREA platform.

steps.title: Activate Impact Index
steps.description: A percentage of organizational growth (skills, hours, or capital) flows into vetted community partners.

steps.title: Track SDG Outcomes
steps.description: Organizations see transparent, data-driven reporting on SDG-aligned outcomes.

sdgs.title: Aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals

impactAreas.title: Impact Areas
impactAreas.subtitle: Three core pillars driving regenerative change across Latin America

pillars.title: Community Regeneration
pillars.description: Support indigenous and rural communities through regenerative tourism, local entrepreneurship, and community-based development.

pillars.title: Women-Led Leadership
pillars.description: Programs to strengthen local women leaders, micro-enterprises, and intergenerational learning.

pillars.title: NGO Strengthening
pillars.description: Apply COIREA's Operating System to help LATAM NGOs build sustainable governance, revenue models, and leadership structures.

howToParticipate.title: How Companies Participate
howToParticipate.subtitle: Three pathways to join the regenerative transformation

pathways.title: Impact Membership
pathways.description: Your main model for ongoing regenerative contribution through the COIREA platform.

pathways.title: Skills-Based Volunteering
pathways.description: Connect your team's expertise with community needs through COIREA's talent network.

pathways.title: Regenerative Capital
pathways.description: Allocate capital towards regenerative projects—like a corporate Founders Pledge.
